body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics showcased its new Chocolate phone during CES 2008, which supports enhanced mobile abilities.

As a work of art in both looks and features, the Chocolate demonstrates that looks are just the beginning of mobile excellence by including a full complement of advanced features that make it one of the most innovative mobile devices in the world, inside and out.
With the availability of new colors in blue, red and light blue, the Chocolate is sure to appeal to the tastes of a wide variety of mobile users.
